status: Prospective Firefox engineering reference, not owner-approved production/SLA/device budget; original numeric caps unchanged.
scope: Official nativeFirefox158 BiDi/headless1440x900, real Nginx/versioned release and isolated same-origin API over a calibrated loopback TCP proxy. Separate shared downstream/upstream serialization clocks across all connections, half latency each direction. HTTP only; no TLS/DNS/packet loss/kernel link/physical device emulation. Same numeric caps as task70 applied prospectively, not identical CDP measurement semantics.

definitions.cold: Fresh browser context and empty HTTP cache; root entry to loaded welcome and usable controls.
definitions.warm: Same context/save/credential/book, native navigation back through root with HTTP cache enabled; root to welcome. Resume same guest and verify once.
definitions.httpBytes: Actual proxy downstream TCP payload bytes written during isolated cold/warm navigation, including HTTP headers/redirects. No TLS/TCP/IP frame overhead; Firefox native cache bypasses proxy and is separately observed via ResourceTiming.
definitions.sampleStatistics: Raw samples and min/max only. Seven samples are not a p95 population or real-device performance proof.
definitions.latency: Each input buffer has half configured minimum delay per direction before globally serialized writes; no TCP handshake/ACK/kernel link emulation.
